job_title: Medical doctor and clinical neuroscience researcher
description: Muhana Fawwazy Ilyas is a medical doctor and AI researcher working on clinical neuroscience, neuro-oncology outcomes, epilepsy, traumatic brain injury, dementia and medical AI.
bio:
I am a medical doctor trained at [Universitas Sebelas Maret](https://uns.ac.id) and am completing a Master of Computer Science in Artificial Intelligence at [Universitas Gadjah Mada](https://ugm.ac.id). My work sits between clinical neuroscience and machine learning.

I study how people recover, or fail to recover, after brain tumours, epilepsy, traumatic brain injury and dementia, and I build interpretable models that make those outcomes easier to predict. I am currently developing the [Atlas of Psychological Outcomes in Neuro-Oncology (APONO)](/atlas), which maps postoperative cognitive and psychological outcomes onto tumour location.

I am also a research assistant in the Functional Neurosurgery Division of the National Brain Center Hospital, Jakarta, and the founder of Riset Inklusif, a platform that teaches clinical research methods to doctors and medical students in Indonesia.
personal: Outside research, I train for long-distance running and enjoy board games.
works_for: National Brain Center Hospital Prof. Dr. dr. Mahar Mardjono, Jakarta
